name: Stella McCartney
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $800 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's tailoring, knitwear, dresses and leather-free bags such as the Falabella, sold through its own stores, site and department stores.

ownership.owner: Stella McCartney Limited (founder-owned; LVMH minority stake bought back in 2025)

quote.q: We strive to create the most beautiful and desirable products with the least impact on our planet.

opview: “We strive to create the most beautiful and desirable products with the least impact on our planet.” — Stella McCartney (house), Sustainability, stellamccartney.com

facts_read.source: brand site; brand terms; World Footwear 2025-02-03; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

Blouse.lp: Arlesa Double Split Hem Zip Blouse

Outerwear.lp: Falabella Chain Light Wash Denim Jacket

price_read.sublines: Stella McCartney women's ready-to-wear and shoes; EXCLUDED: artist collaborations (signed Jeff Koons tees), adidas by Stella McCartney (separate line), Stellawear lingerie, bags

doors.note: US: Bal Harbour, SoHo (112 Greene), South Coast Plaza; outlet at Woodbury Common.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 across 12 derived categories, proportional; 348 styles from the 377 products the Women > Ready-to-wear grid states (all 8 pages read); 9

tech_evidence.names: Brewed Protein (Spiber, licensed; one knit); 'technical polyamide blend' named on a bomber without a trademark

craft_evidence.owned: no — supplier policies and an Ethical Trading Initiative membership are published, but no owned facility
craft_evidence.mills: no — PDPs name certifications (RWS, GOTS, CanopyStyle) not mills
craft_evidence.madein: 94% (75 of 80 sampled: Italy 41, Romania 15, Portugal 9, Hungary 7, Bulgaria 3)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — house launched 2001, first collection shown in Paris that October
craft_evidence.process: materials, not making — sustainability statement and per-PDP sourcing notes; no garment-making process
craft_evidence.reasoning: Product pages state a country (mostly Italy, then Romania, Portugal, Hungary) and the founding is dated (2001, Paris). The brand documents fibre sourcing in detail but names no factory, maker or mill and owns no making, so on craft as briefed it is a 2.
